items.title: Isidore Barbarin Interview, 1959-01-07
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] well ask what kind of a band Robichaud had John Robichaud ... [INTERVIEWEE] oh oh yes true yes okay he used to play in the brass band you know but he had a real orchestra

ctx.x: Robichaux and the brass band. And then they had another band.
They had the string band, the jazz band. And the feel. And the feel, you know? Out in the feel, they had the other jazz string band. That was Eagle Band.
